models.name: recurly__account_overview
models.description: Each record represents an account, enriched with metrics about their associated transactions. Use the most recent record if multiple records exist for the same account id.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Primary key for the account.

columns.name: account_created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the account entry was created.

columns.name: account_code
columns.description: The unique identifier of the account. This cannot be changed once the account is created. Provided during account creation.

columns.name: account_company
columns.description: The company related with the account.

columns.name: account_country
columns.description: Country in the world the account is associated with.

columns.name: account_email
columns.description: Email address associated with the account.

columns.name: account_state
columns.description: Current state of the account.

columns.name: account_username
columns.description: A secondary value for the account.

columns.name: total_transactions
columns.description: Total amount of unique transactions issued to this account. Set to 0 if no transactions.

columns.name: total_invoices
columns.description: Total amount of unique invoices issued to this account. Set to 0 if no invoices.

columns.name: total_charges
columns.description: Total amount of charges issued to this account. Set to 0 if no charges.

columns.name: total_credits
columns.description: Total amount of credits issued to this account. Set to 0 if no credits.

columns.name: total_balance
columns.description: Gross amount of all transactions made with this account. Set to 0 if no transactions.

columns.name: total_discounts
columns.description: Total amount of discounts issued to this account. Set to 0 if no discounts.

columns.name: total_taxes
columns.description: Total amount of taxes issued to this account. Set to 0 if no taxes.

columns.name: total_charge_count
columns.description: Total number of charges issued to this account. Set to 0 if no charges.

columns.name: total_credit_count
columns.description: Total number of credits issued to this account. Set to 0 if no credits.

columns.name: first_charge_date
columns.description: Date the first charge on the account was issued.

columns.name: most_recent_charge_date
columns.description: Date the most recent charge on the account was issued.

columns.name: first_invoice_date
columns.description: Date the first invoice on the account was issued.

columns.name: most_recent_invoice_date
columns.description: Date the most recent invoice on the account was issued.

columns.name: first_transaction_date
columns.description: Date first transaction occurred on the account.

columns.name: most_recent_transaction_date
columns.description: Date most recent transaction occurred on the account.

models.name: recurly__balance_transactions
models.description: Each record represents a specific line item charge, credit, or other balance change that accumulates into the final invoices.

columns.name: balance_transaction_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the balance transaction line item

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the line item was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: When the line item was last updated.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Customer in Recurly responsible for the line item.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice in Recurly these line items are associated with.

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: If VAT taxation and the Country Invoice Sequencing feature are enabled, invoices will have country-specific invoice numbers for invoices billed to EU countries (e.g. FR1001). Non-EU invoices will continue to use the site-level invoice number sequence.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Charges are positive line items that debit the account. Credits are negative line items that credit the account. Enum, "charge", "credit"

columns.name: state
columns.description: Pending line items are charges or credits on an account that have not been applied to an invoice yet. Invoiced line items will always have an invoice_id value. Enum, "invoiced", "pending"

columns.name: origin
columns.description: A credit created from an original charge will have the value of the charge's origin. Enum, "add_on", "add_on_trial", "carryforward", "coupon", "credit", "debit", "one_time", "plan", "plan_trial", "setup_fee", "prepayment".

columns.name: discount
columns.description: The discount applied to the line item.

columns.name: tax
columns.description: The tax amount for the line item.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Description that appears on the invoice. For subscription related items this will be filled in automatically.

columns.name: has_refund
columns.description: True if the line item is refund, false if it is not.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Total after discounts and taxes (quantity * unit_amount) - (discount + tax).

columns.name: credit_applied
columns.description: The amount of credit from this line item that was applied to the invoice.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: This number will be multiplied by the unit amount to compute the subtotal before any discounts or taxes.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: Positive amount for a charge, negative amount for a credit.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Total before discounts and taxes (quantity * unit_amount).

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: If an end date is present, this is value indicates the beginning of a billing time range. If no end date is present it indicates billing for a specific date.

columns.name: invoice_state
columns.description: The invoice state. Enum, "open", "pending", "processing", "past_due", "paid", "closed", "failed", "voided".

columns.name: invoice_origin
columns.description: The event that created the invoice. Enum, "credit", "gift_card", "immediate_change", "line_item_refund", "open_amount_refund", "purchase", "renewal", "termination", "write_off", "prepayment".

columns.name: invoice_type
columns.description: Invoices are either "charge", "credit", or "legacy" invoices.

columns.name: invoice_created_at
columns.description: When the invoice was created.

columns.name: invoice_due_at
columns.description: Date invoice is due. This is the date the net terms are reached.

columns.name: invoice_closed_at
columns.description: Date invoice was marked paid or failed.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: The id of the transaction associated with the invoice.

columns.name: transaction_created_at
columns.description: Time transaction was created.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description:
Transaction types:
  authorization: verifies billing information and places a hold on money in the customer's account.
  capture: captures funds held by an authorization and completes a purchase.
  purchase: combines the authorization and capture in one transaction.
  refund: returns all or a portion of the money collected in a previous transaction to the customer.
  verify: a $0 or $1 transaction used to verify billing information which is immediately voided.
Enum: "authorization", "capture", "purchase", "refund", "verify"

columns.name: transaction_origin
columns.description: Describes how the transaction was triggered. Enum, "api", "chargeback", "force_collect", "hpp", "merchant", "recurly_admin", "recurlyjs", "recurring", "refunded_externally", "transparent"

columns.name: transaction_status
columns.description: The current transaction status. Note that the status may change, e.g. a pending transaction may become declined or success may later become void. Enum:"chargeback", "declined", "error", "pending", "processing", "scheduled", "success", "void"

columns.name: transaction_billing_country
columns.description: Billing info - Country, 2-letter ISO code.

columns.name: transaction_payment_method_object
columns.description: Examples include: "amazon", "amazon_billing_agreement", "apple_pay", "bank_account_info", "check", "credit_card", "eft", "debit", "gateway_token", "iban_bank_account", "money_order", "other", "paypal", "paypal_billing_agreement", "roku",  "sepadirectdebit", "wire_transfer"

models.name: recurly__churn_analysis
models.description: Each record represents a subscription and their churn status and details.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the subscription.

columns.name: activated_at
columns.description: When the subscription was activated.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The account this subscription belongs to.

columns.name: account_state
columns.description: Current state of the account.

columns.name: canceled_at
columns.description: When the subscription was canceled. Can take future dates.

columns.name: current_period_ended_at
columns.description: Current billing period ends at.

columns.name: current_period_started_at
columns.description: Current billing period started at.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: When the subscription has expired. Can take future dates.

columns.name: expiration_reason
columns.description: Reason for subscription expiration.

columns.name: has_auto_renew
columns.description: Whether the subscription renews at the end of its term. Default:true

columns.name: plan_name
columns.description: This name describes your plan and will appear on the Hosted Payment Page and the subscriber's invoice.

columns.name: plan_state
columns.description: The current state of the plan. Enum:"active", "inactive"

columns.name: subscription_end_date
columns.description: When the subscription actually ends, factors in cancellations earlier than the expected end date.

columns.name: subscription_interval_days
columns.description: Subscription interval by number of days, accounting for cancelled/expired periods.

columns.name: subscription_state
columns.description: The current state of the subscription. Enum:"active", "canceled", "expired", "failed", "future", "paused"

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Estimated total, before tax.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: Subscription unit price.

columns.name: churn_reason
columns.description: Reason for churn. null if subscription has no expiration date. Enum:"account closed", "canceled", "gift ended", "non-payment", "non-renewing", "tax location invalid", "trial ended"

columns.name: churn_reason_type
columns.description: Type of churn, null if subscription has no expiration date. Enum:"involuntary", "voluntary"

models.name: recurly__subscription_overview
models.description: Each record represents a subscription, enriched with metrics about time, revenue, state, and period. Use the most recent record if multiple records exist for the same subscription id.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the subscription.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: When the subscription was updated.

columns.name: activated_at
columns.description: When the subscription was activated.

columns.name: add_ons_total
columns.description: Total price of add-ons. Greater or equal to 0.

columns.name: canceled_at
columns.description: When the subscription was canceled. Can take future dates.

columns.name: current_period_ended_at
columns.description: Current billing period ends at.

columns.name: current_period_started_at
columns.description: Current billing period started at.

columns.name: expiration_reason
columns.description: Reason for subscription expiration.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: When the subscription has expired. Can take future dates.

columns.name: has_auto_renew
columns.description: Whether the subscription renews at the end of its term. Default:true

columns.name: subscription_state
columns.description: The current state of the subscription. Enum:"active", "canceled", "expired", "failed", "future", "paused"

columns.name: subscription_end_date
columns.description: When the subscription actually ends, factors in cancellations earlier than the expected end date.

columns.name: subscription_interval_days
columns.description: Subscription interval by number of days, accounting for cancelled/expired periods.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Estimated total, before tax.

columns.name: trial_ends_at
columns.description: Trial period ends at.

columns.name: trial_started_at
columns.description: Trial period started at.

columns.name: trial_interval_days
columns.description: Period of trial, in days.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: Subscription unit price.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The account this subscription belongs to.

columns.name: account_created_at
columns.description: The date this account was created.

columns.name: account_email
columns.description: Email address associated with the account for this subscription.

columns.name: account_state
columns.description: Current state of the account.

columns.name: plan_code
columns.description: Unique code to identify the plan. This is used in Hosted Payment Page URLs and in the invoice exports.

columns.name: plan_created_at
columns.description: When the plan was created.

columns.name: plan_deleted_at
columns.description: When the plan was deleted.

columns.name: plan_interval_days
columns.description: The number of days on the expected Recurly plan. Assume a month has 30 days.

columns.name: plan_is_tax_exempt
columns.description: true exempts tax on the plan, false applies tax on the plan.

columns.name: plan_name
columns.description: This name describes your plan and will appear on the Hosted Payment Page and the subscriber's invoice.

columns.name: plan_state
columns.description: The current state of the plan. Enum:"active", "inactive"

columns.name: plan_total_billing_cycles
columns.description: Automatically terminate subscriptions after a defined number of billing cycles. Number of billing cycles before the plan automatically stops renewing, defaults to null for continuous, automatic renewal.
